production.note: US model years 2016-2018. First: Ford's 2016 Focus US brochure lists the '2016 Focus RS'. Last: the 2018 Focus RS Limited Edition marked 'the end of the latter car's run' (Motor Authority, Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 12 June 2017; motorauthority-focus-rs-limited-2018), and Car and Driver's specifications cover the 2018 car (caranddriver-2018-focus-rs-specs).

drivetrain.note: 'Ford Performance All-Wheel Drive with Dynamic Torque Vectoring'

powerHp.note: Quote (Ford 2016 US brochure): '350 hp @ 6,000 rpm'. The rating did not change through 2018.

weightLb.note: Car and Driver's specifications section for the 2018 Focus RS (the maker's figures, not a road-test measurement), read by the project owner on 3 October 2026 (the site blocks the research tools): curb weight 3,434 lb. Weight-order step 2. No Ford curb weight could be opened, and no qualifying 2016 or 2017 figure was found, so 2018 is the reference year. CarPro (Terry Box) gives 3,459 lb; see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's 2018 specifications give 3,434 lb; CarPro's 2017 review gives 3,459 lb.
discrepancies.resolution: Car and Driver's specification panel qualifies on its own (step 2); CarPro is a single outlet. 3,434 lb is used.
